newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian cen.bank foreign assets rose in November.
newsitem.headline: Latvian cen.bank foreign assets rose in November.

text.p: Foreign assets of the Latvian central bank rose to 332.2 million lats in November from 324.5 million lats in October, the central bank said on Tuesday.
It also said in a statement that currency in circulation rose to 262.8 million lats in November from 260.6 million lats in October.

But the central bank said total deposits in banks slipped in November to 338.3 million lats from 352.6 million lats in October and banks' net foreign assets fell in November to 421.8 million lats from 428.7 million lats the previous month.
The bank also said that the volume of credits on the domestic interbank market rose in November to 96.6 million lats versus 53.1 million lats in October.
